title: Mooney M20J 201 — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Mooney M20J 201 with Lycoming IO-360 fuel-injected engine, constant-speed propeller, and electric retractable tricycle gear. The IO-360 is fuel-injected and not susceptible to carburetor icing. Fuel selector has LEFT, BOTH, and RIGHT positions; BOTH is required for takeoff and landing. The 201 uses an electric gear system; some earlier M20 variants used a manual Johnson bar — verify the gear system on the specific aircraft. Speed brakes are an optional installation; check the specific aircraft for their presence. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, and performance limitations must come from the specific aircraft POH. Not a substitute for qualified instruction or currency in type.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, or other numerical limitations — all must come from the specific aircraft POH.
Equipment varies across M20J airframes, including gear actuation type, avionics fit, and optional speed brakes. Verify every item against the specific aircraft before use.
